meta.name: The Legend of Hanuman
meta.description: When the power-hungry Ravan tore through the world to unleash evil, in his way stood a humble vaanar awoken to his divinity to become an immortal legend. The series follows Hanuman and his transformation from a mighty warrior to a god and how Hanuman became the beacon of hope amidst the harrowing darkness.

videos.title: The Legend Begins
videos.overview: Since his powers were bound in childhood, Hanuman now lives as a simple vaanar warrior serving King Sugreev, until an encounter with two human princes sets him on a new path.

videos.title: The Monkey King
videos.overview: Hanuman takes Ram and Lakshman to meet the exiled vaanar king. Sugreev has doubts about the humans and suspects they might be agents of his brother, Vaali.

videos.title: Kishkindha Bound
videos.overview: Sugreev accepts Ram's help and journeys with Hanuman to Kishkindha to win back his kingdom and his beloved wife, Ruma. But first he must face his brother, the tyrant Vaali.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: Lost in celebration of his victory over Vaali, Sugreev faces the consequences of being an oathbreaker. Meanwhile, Prince Angad struggles with the death of his father.

videos.title: Spirits of the Forest
videos.overview: As Hanuman begins his search for Sita, Angad encounters the peaceful spirits of the forest and learns of the darkness that hunts them

videos.title: Darkness Rises
videos.overview: While Angad and Hanuman must learn to work together, a dark force from Ram's past sets its eyes upon the vaanars to stop their quest.

videos.title: The Yaksha King
videos.overview: Hanuman and the group are taken to the kingdom of Yakshas where they find themselves trapped by dark vines and a vengeful king.

videos.title: Enter the Void
videos.overview: As Angad descends further into darkness, Hanuman faces the evil forces within the vines. At the same time, Jambhvan must show his strength to save his friends.

videos.title: The Cave
videos.overview: To save Angad, the group must enter the mysterious cave of Rikshabila, a place of danger, deception and death.

videos.title: Indra's Curse
videos.overview: Hanuman's team faces a devastating revelation that challenges their loyalties. Later, they encounter the strange Vaalakhilya and learn of their curse.

videos.title: Sampati Rises
videos.overview: Sampati, the elder brother of the great Jatayu, rises from his slumber. But is the anguished creature friend or foe?

videos.title: The Mango and the Sun
videos.overview: Hanuman hears voices in the wind and wonders if something is wrong. That is when Jambhvan helps him confront memories of a life forgotten.

videos.title: Forgotten Truths
videos.overview: Hanuman learns the truth about himself as Vayu reveals to him what it means to be a divine hero and an immortal.

videos.title: Leap of Faith
videos.overview: Hanuman encounters an unexpected challenge on his leap to Lanka as Surasa tests his strength.

videos.title: Simhika Rises
videos.overview: Indrajit unleashes the ravenous Simhika. Hanuman must come to terms with his newfound powers.

videos.title: Ravan
videos.overview: Hanuman finally makes it to Lanka, but what awaits him in the land of demons is something completely unexpected.

videos.title: Ashok Vana
videos.overview: Hanuman desperately searches for Sita. Ravan determines there is only one way to end his obsession.

videos.title: Sita's Strength
videos.overview: Sita stands defiant against Ravan and his demons. As Mandodari learns a sad truth, the Demon King strikes a bargain.

videos.title: Message Received
videos.overview: Hanuman delivers Ram's message to Sita and prepares to send another message to Ravan. Meanwhile, King Suketu visits Ram.

videos.title: Son of the Demon
videos.overview: Hanuman faces Ravan's elite kinkara warriors. Prince Akshay struggles to make his father proud.

videos.title: Prison of Illusions
videos.overview: Ravan and Mandodari deal with the death of their son. When Indrajit searches for vengeance and glory, Hanuman faces his darkest fears.

videos.title: Immortals
videos.overview: Hanuman is brought in chains before Ravan as the Demon King reveals a troubling secret about immortality.

videos.title: Dance of Fire
videos.overview: Hanuman plans his escape to ensure Sita's message reaches Ram. Ravan prepares a fiery punishment for the death of his son.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: After Lanka's destruction, Vibheeshan confronts Ravan and his obsession with Sita. Hanuman returns to his kingdom where Ram and King Sugreev restlessly await.

videos.title: Ocean Apart
videos.overview: Hanuman is reunited with the vaanars and Ram. As they march to wage war on Lanka, an endless ocean creates a new challenge.

videos.title: War Begins
videos.overview: Ram unleashes his deadliest power against the ocean. Ravan rallies his armies to prepare for war. Hanuman raises his flag.

videos.title: Lanka
videos.overview: On the shores of Lanka, Ram and his army begin the battle against Ravan's forces to determine the fate of the universe.

videos.title: Serpent's Kiss
videos.overview: The vaanars, along with Vibheeshan, try to parley with Ravan. Ram and Lakshman meet Indrajit in battle and face his deadly Nagastra weapons.

videos.title: Ravan Unleashed
videos.overview: As tragedy looms over the vaanar camp, Hanuman fights to survive his first battlefield encounter with the demon king.

videos.title: Forgotten Son
videos.overview: Ravan's banished son Ahiravan is summoned home to Lanka. Meanwhile, the demon king has a backup plan.

videos.title: Terror from the Sky
videos.overview: The winged demon Vajramushti is sent to destroy Lord Ram. Ahiravan returns to Lanka with a surprise guest and warns Ravan of the consequences of waking a cursed demon.

videos.title: The Mountain Awakens
videos.overview: Indrajit and Ahiravan are commanded by Ravan to awaken a terrifying power. But once unleashed, can it ever be stopped?

videos.title: Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: As the war rages on, Ravan's complex past and relationships with his brothers come to light, setting the stage for an epic confrontation that will determine the fate of Lanka.

videos.title: The Unlikely Heroes
videos.overview: Two unlikely vaanar heroes, Nal and Nil, embark on a daring mission to rescue their captured king, Sugreev, from the clutches of the rakshasas.

videos.title: Wrath of the Giant
videos.overview: The vaanar army faces its greatest challenge yet when the colossal and seemingly invincible rakshas warrior Kumbhakaran enters the battlefield.

videos.title: The Price of War
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Indrajit's devastating attack, the vaanar army grapples with immense loss as the cost of war is laid bare. Hanuman embarks on a risky quest to save his comrades.

videos.title: Whispers in the Dark
videos.overview: Hanuman and Lakshman set out on a risky night mission to uncover the secret behind Indrajit's invincibility and put an end to his reign of terror.

videos.title: A Father's Shadow
videos.overview: Lakshman and Indrajit clash in a battle that will echo through the ages, and Ravan comes to terms with the weight of his son's legacy and the price of his ambition.

videos.title: Into the Abyss
videos.overview: When Ram and Lakshman are mysteriously transported to Patal Loka, Hanuman navigates treacherous realms to rescue them as Ravan unleashes his fury upon the world.

videos.title: The Son of Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman encounters a formidable foe who claims an impossible lineage, setting the stage for an earth-shattering revelation.

videos.title: Shadows of Patal Loka
videos.overview: In the depths of Patal Loka, an unlikely ally joins Hanuman's quest as Ravan unleashes a terrifying new menace upon the battlefield.

videos.title: A Sister's Farewell
videos.overview: A mysterious village holds dark secrets that threaten to entrap Hanuman and his companion. In Lanka, a heart-wrenching decision must be made.

videos.title: The Palace of Illusions
videos.overview: As Hanuman navigates a labyrinth of deception, Ahiravan sets in motion a sinister plan that could forever alter the balance of power.

videos.title: Panchamukha
videos.overview: With reality unravelling, Hanuman and his allies must make a hard choice to prevent an unspeakable evil from achieving godhood.

videos.title: Ten Faces of the Demon
videos.overview: In the aftermath of an epic battle, Hanuman bids farewell to a loved one, unaware that a new danger lurks just beyond the horizon.

videos.title: The Nine Faces of Ravan
videos.overview: As armies clash on the battlefield, an unlikely hero must play a deadly game with the demon king, where every move could mean life or death.

videos.title: The Deadly Game
videos.overview: As armies clash on the battlefield, an unlikely hero must play a deadly game with the demon king, where every move could mean life or death.

videos.title: Strength and Honour
videos.overview: When two legendary warriors meet in the dark of night, their contest of strength reveals that the true battle lies not in their fists but in their spirits.

videos.title: The Price of Mercy
videos.overview: Ravan is tormented by his past, as a choice made generations ago ripples across centuries to haunt him in ways he never imagined.

videos.title: Gods and Demons
videos.overview: As night descends on Lanka, Ram faces Ravan in a deadly battle where his greatest fear may become a reality.

videos.title: Race Against Dawn
videos.overview: As Ravan commands the sun itself to rise, Hanuman must race against time to save Lakshman's life before dawn breaks over Lanka.

videos.title: The Mountain
videos.overview: A mountain, a sunrise and the fate of the universe hang in balance as legends collide in the epic season finale.

videos.title: Weapons of Will
videos.overview: As Ravan becomes invincible and the vaanar army falls, Vibheeshan reveals a slim hope: a weapon that can slay an immortal. Hanuman slips into Lanka on a dangerous gambit.

videos.title: Stolen Breath
videos.overview: While executing his risky plan inside Lanka, Hanuman recounts the day his father's fury shook the heavens. But Ravan is always one step ahead. Far out at sea, a new threat stirs.

videos.title: Daughter of the Demon
videos.overview: A strange new power begins to awaken in Hanuman, which makes Jambhvan wary. Ravan's daughter rises from the depths of the ocean, and Hanuman seeks her to turn her away from war.

videos.title: Timingila Rises
videos.overview: A colossal terror erupts from the sea, trapping the vaanars between it and the demon army. Hanuman tests the limits of his new powers as the cost of war strikes closer to home.

videos.title: Princes of the Past
videos.overview: Far from the battlefield, Hanuman finds himself somewhere he was never meant to be. Only one man knows who he is and warns him that a single wrong step could unravel everything.

videos.title: The Cosmic Dance
videos.overview: Hanuman comes face-to-face with an enemy in a different time, and an encounter beyond the mortal realm draws him toward a truth about himself he never imagined.

videos.title: At Death's Door
videos.overview: Hanuman ventures into a realm no living soul should enter. There he meets old foes, and an impossible bargain must be struck.

videos.title: Rudra Avatar
videos.overview: One demon. An entire army. And no weapon that can stop him. As Lanka's darkest dawn breaks, a power born of the cosmos itself descends to meet Ravan.
